caption: The drawing features a single rooster, rendered in shades of gray, standing on a horizontal bar. The rooster is positioned in profile, facing left, with a prominent comb and an elaborate, curved tail. Its body, wings, and feathers are detailed with subtle shading. Below the bar, a vertical support connects to a large, solid gray sphere. Underneath the sphere, there is a triangular shape with lines radiating downward, possibly meant to indicate a base or support. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the overall composition is centered on the page, with some artist notation or signature in the lower right corner.
title: Weather Vane - Iron Rooster
